expansion: they pressed forward through the gathering storm.
they traced faint footprints in the damp earth.
they questioned a nervous innkeeper until the truth slipped out.
they deciphered a map whose ink shifted in the moonlight.
they bartered with a merchant who feared to speak too loudly.
they climbed a crumbling stair that groaned under every step.
they hid among hanging banners as guards passed below.
they followed a river until the banks turned to black stone.
they lit a lantern whose flame burned an unnatural blue.
they listened at a door and heard whispered plotting inside.
they patched their wounds with torn cloth and grim determination.
they forged a letter sealed with wax they had stolen earlier.
they raced across rooftops while dogs barked in the alleys.
they uncovered a hatch buried beneath rotted floorboards.
they swore an oath over a cup of bitter wine.
they challenged a sentry with a lie so bold it almost worked.
they repaired a bridge of rope just enough to cross once.
they studied constellations that no chart had ever named.
they traded their last coin for a rumor and a crust of bread.
they slipped through a market crowd like smoke between fingers.
they woke before dawn to practice a sword form in silence.
they followed the scent of smoke to a hidden encampment.
they copied a sigil from memory onto a scrap of parchment.
they calmed a spooked horse while arrows hissed overhead.
they pried open a chest lined with rusted iron nails.
they argued in whispers until a compromise finally took shape.
they crossed a rope bridge swaying above a gorge of mist.
they knelt in a shrine and left an offering of silver and ash.
they tracked mud into a hall where every eye turned cold.
they broke a lock with a tool that bent and nearly snapped.
they read aloud a verse that made the candles gutter low.
they scaled a cliff face while seabirds screamed above them.
they shared a meal with strangers who knew too much about the road.
they burned evidence in a stove until the smoke stung their eyes.
they disguised themselves as pilgrims bound for a distant shrine.
they followed a trail of petals into a garden gone wild.
they negotiated passage with a ferryman who demanded a story.
they uncovered a tunnel sealed behind a false hearthstone.
they tended a fever with herbs gathered by starlight.
they sparred until sweat blurred their vision and pride softened.
they decoded drumbeats echoing from the hills at night.
they pressed a handprint into wet clay to seal a bargain.
they outran a landslide with seconds to spare.
they memorized a passphrase repeated only once.
they patched a sail while lightning stitched the horizon.
they confronted a childhood friend who wore a stranger's smile.
they traced a vein of crystal pulsing faintly in the rock.
they learned a dance step that opened a secret door.
they carried a wounded ally until their shoulders went numb.
they swam a channel where bioluminescent creatures swirled like stars.
they rang a bell that had not sounded in a hundred years.
they chose a fork in the road that looked like no choice at all.
they bound a promise with thread, knot, and a cut palm.
they watched the city gates close and knew there was no turning back.
they shattered a mirror and stepped through the wrong reflection.
they planted a seed in cursed soil and waited for an answer.
